title: Migrax
description: Database migrations generated from your JPA and Hibernate entities, with rollback scripts, lint checks and verification before they reach production.

items.title: Stop using ddl-auto=update in production
items.content_html: What spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update really does to a database with data in it, shown on a real run, and how to switch an existing database to reviewed migrations without starting over.

items.title: Renaming columns and tables without losing data
items.content_html: Rename an entity field or a whole table and keep every row. How Migrax tells a rename apart from a drop, what it does in CI, and the SQL it writes.

items.title: Migrax vs Flyway: generated vs hand-written migrations
items.content_html: Migrax and Flyway side by side on the same change: what each one writes, checks and can undo, which features cost money, where Flyway is the better choice, and how to switch.

items.title: Generated SQL migrations for Python, TypeScript and Go projects
items.content_html: Your ORM already knows the schema. Export it as SQL, and Migrax writes versioned migrations with rollback scripts for SQLAlchemy, Drizzle and GORM projects, then checks them in CI.

items.title: Generate SQL migrations from your JPA entities
items.content_html: Change a JPA entity, run one command, and get a reviewed SQL migration with its rollback script. A walk through Migrax on a small Hibernate and PostgreSQL project.

items.title: Catching schema drift before it breaks production
items.content_html: Someone changed production by hand. How migrax drift finds it, how to keep the changes you want and undo the rest, and how to stop the application from starting on a drifted database.

items.title: Applying and undoing: migrate, status, rollback
items.content_html: See what is pending, apply migrations all at once or one at a time, hand a script to a DBA, and undo with rollback scripts. migrate, status and rollback on a real project.
